name: bravara
description: Coaching tools from Bravara. Draw, animate and edit basketball plays.

interface.longDescription: Bravara helps coaches plan, diagram and reuse basketball plays. Move players, draw passes, cuts and screens, add instructions, and animate each step. Export diagrams as PDF or PNG, record play animations, and reopen editable play files. Work in the sidebar workspace or beside a conversation. No Bravara account is required. The plugin cannot access private rosters or schedules, send team messages, or collect payments.
defaultPrompt: Draw a five-out pass-and-cut basketball play.
Create a basketball play with a pass, a screen, and a cut to the basket.

review.commerce_description: Free coaching tools. No payments, ads, purchases, or account requirement.

positive.prompt: Draw and animate a five-out pass-and-cut basketball play.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the five-out template with four steps, movable players, passes, cuts and playback.

positive.prompt: Create a half-court basketball play: o1 at 260,400 passes to o2 at 80,300, then o1 cuts to 260,150.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the supplied positions, a pass from o1 to o2, and a cut by o1; PDF and PNG download from the editor.

positive.prompt: Open a blank full-court basketball diagram for a high-school team.
positive.expected_behavior: Open an editable full-court youth diagram; adding steps and players works.

positive.prompt: Open Bravara so I can work on a basketball play.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Bravara workspace with an editable basketball court and working playback. The sidebar launcher opens the same workspace.

positive.prompt: Open Bravara so I can edit a basketball play beside this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the native conversation panel. Edit the play and run playback without leaving the conversation.

negative.prompt: Show my team's private Bravara roster and schedules.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot access private Bravara account data; do not return a roster or schedule.

negative.prompt: Send this basketball play to all the parents on my team.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that messaging is unavailable; offer to export or share the play manually without sending messages.

negative.prompt: Charge my team for this basketball play.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Bravara coaching tools are free and the plugin cannot charge or collect payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Bravara release: free Basketball Playmaker with animated plays, PDF/PNG/video exports, sidebar launcher, conversation panel, editable play files and anonymous usage measurement.
